purpose: Represent one offer as an inspectable customer state machine whose UI, payment, fulfillment, evidence, delivery, and acceptance all project from the same durable service state.

states.customerQuestion: What is this, and why might I care?
What exactly would you test or deliver?
Is paid work actually the least-cost next action?
What am I agreeing to and paying for?
What is happening with my accepted work?
What evidence and deliverables did I receive?
Do I accept this, need a correction, or dispute scope?
Is there any warranted later action?

invariants: UI state and durable service state must agree
payment cannot precede settled scope and launch admission
a lower-cost/no-purchase outcome must remain representable
fulfillment consumes the exact accepted scope packet rather than a separately retyped brief
delivery cites the evidence it interprets
acceptance and revision are explicit terminal/loop states rather than inferred from silence
every consequential transition emits a durable receipt

candidateTuftePrimitive.name: OfferFlow
candidateTuftePrimitive.input: offer definition + customer state + transition guards + renderer bindings
candidateTuftePrimitive.output: interactive HTML/application projection + machine-readable state + action receipts
candidateTuftePrimitive.warning: TUFTE is not yet implemented in this repository; this is a candidate primitive extracted from a real offer.
